schedules.purpose: Own commercial-terms schedule behavior, read models, and UI contracts.
schedules.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

agreements.purpose: Own commercial-agreement behavior, read models, and UI contracts for account-specific overrides.
agreements.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

resolutions.purpose: Own commercial-terms-resolution APIs, projections, and resolver queries.
resolutions.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

request-support.purpose: Provide reusable request-support assets shared by commercial-terms features and route adapters.
request-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
request-support.justification: request-support centralizes context-local request composition for admin routes.
request-support.createdFor: commercial-terms admin workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
request-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

runtime-support.purpose: Provide reusable runtime-support assets shared by commercial-terms-owned features and composition seams.
runtime-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
runtime-support.justification: runtime-support centralizes event-store composition and common fee math.
runtime-support.createdFor: commercial-terms workflows that span multiple features or public entrypoints.
runtime-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

seed-support.purpose: Provide reusable seed-support assets shared by commercial-terms-owned features and composition seams.
seed-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one feature and cross-feature reuse is explicit.
seed-support.justification: seed-support centralizes deterministic schedule and agreement identifiers for tests and bootstrap.
seed-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into feature-local modules.

routes.purpose: Expose commercial-terms-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
routes.allowedWhen: Required whenever the context contributes routes to any deployable.
